text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day. Agnes Digital arrived,
carefully holding a package of chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"T-T-Trainer-san!
Alright, are you ready?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Today is the festival of ships—Valentine's Day!
And with it, handmade chocolates packed with so much ginormous love they'll make you go "Whoa!?"
choice_data_list: Who are you giving that to?
Who are you giving that to?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Together, to the altar, we shall offer it up!

"...It never even became a conversation about giving it to anyone.
A handmade household altar by Agnes Digital
was brought right into the Trainer's office..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Come, come, please enjoy the feast,
my dear Umamusume. In my imagination, that is..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, even without you actually tasting it,
I can already see... the look on your face...
Hnnngh...!"
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to hand it over directly?
Aren't you going to hand it over directly?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-No way! Handing it over in person
to someone I look up to so much?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"If I actually gave it to them, they'd feel obligated
to return the favor, which would just be a burden on them."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Besides, expecting someone to understand
how you feel is presumptuous to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
An oshi is best cherished from afar. This is Digi-tan's
stealth Valentine's Day style.

Agnes Digital doesn't ask for anything in return
from anyone. If so, maybe this is fine as it is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Alright, with that done, Trainer-san.
We've finished praying, so let's eat together!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Once the offerings are made,
it's time to eat chocolate and gush
over how precious our fave is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I am truly blessed.
To think I'd come across a comrade with whom
I can talk about our love for Umamusume like this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san, please open your heart to me without hiding anything.
Lately, who is... your ultimate favorite?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll confess too! The thing that I've been so, so obsessed with lately is...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nnnngh, there're way too many,
I can't choose~~~!!

Agnes Digital looked thrilled even while writhing in ecstasy.
Sharing some chocolates, we chatted away happily about Umamusume.

I don't know if I can call her my "absolute favorite"...
but as her Trainer—
choice_data_list: Here, I'll give you some chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes, chocolate for me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAT!?
Aieee! Why chocolate?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-T-To me, Digitan, out of nowhere?
Even if you suddenly put me on a pedestal, I can't...!
choice_data_list: Eat this and keep doing your best.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-What boundless benevolence...
Are you telling me you'd stan even a humble spectator like me on Valentine's Day?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
As expected of an Umamusume-loving Trainer!
To think you'd even support something so niche.
Ah, a true kindred spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You are truly a model otaku. Today,
I received something far more precious than chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If it's with you, I could spend Valentine's Day
together for the next five, even ten years!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And so, let us continue to dedicate our love to Umamusume.
Together, before the altar... let us swear an oath!

Urged on, I swore an oath.
Just as I would support Agnes Digital, I would also support the things she supports.
